{mx:site_owner_bio}I started Summit Roofing because I was tired of seeing homeowners get burned by cowboys. We are a small local team, we answer the phone, we turn up when we say we will, and we treat your home like our own.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_name}Roof Repairs{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_slug}roof-repairs{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_desc}Leaks, cracked tiles and broken flashing found and fixed fast, with photos before and after.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_name}Roof Restoration{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_slug}roof-restoration{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_desc}Clean, repair, re-point and re-coat to add 15+ years to your roof for a fraction of a replacement.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_name}Re-Roofing{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_slug}re-roofing{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_desc}Full tile-to-metal and metal-to-metal replacements with a clean site every day.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_name}Storm Damage{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_slug}storm-damage{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_desc}Emergency make-safe and insurance-ready reports after hail, wind and storm events.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_name}Gutters and Downpipes{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_slug}gutters-downpipes{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_desc}New gutters, downpipes and guards that stop overflow and protect your foundations.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_name}Roof Inspections{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_slug}roof-inspections{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_desc}Detailed photo reports for buyers, sellers and insurers, usually within 48 hours.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_1_q}How much does a roof repair cost?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_1_a}Most repairs fall between $350 and $1,500 depending on access and materials. We give you a fixed written price before any work starts, so there are no surprises.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_q}How quickly can you come out?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_a}We usually inspect within 1 to 2 business days, and same day for active leaks and storm damage.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_q}Are you licensed and insured?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_a}Yes. We hold a current QBCC licence and full public liability insurance, and we are happy to send certificates before we start.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_q}Do you offer a guarantee?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_a}Every job comes with our 10-year workmanship guarantee on top of the manufacturer warranty on materials.{/mx}
